bibl.title: The camel in the Nabataean realm.
bibl.seg: Laïla Nehmé, The camel in the Nabataean realm.
Damien Agut-Labordère & Bérangère Redon (edd.), Les vaisseaux du désert et des steppes. Les camélidés dans l'Antiquité (Camelus dromedarius et Camelus bactrianus) (Lyon, 2020) pp. 207-226, figg.
bibl.note: Aims at presenting a synthesis on what we know about the uses of the dromedary (Camelus dromedarius) in the Nabataean realm from the archaeological and epigraphic sources. It is based on various categories of material, including Nabataean inscriptions, terracotta figurines and rock cut reliefs. - Practical, domestic and utilitarian uses. - Funerary and religious contexts. - Camels in the Nabataean caravan trade. - Military and symbolic aspects.
